devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Every device this hms-cpap reads or talks to, whether it is here now, and what it can do.
devices.loadError: The devices could not be read: {{error}}

empty.heading: No device yet
empty.streaming: A Mule & Miner or a Sleep Bridge comes here once it is pointed at this computer from its own setup page: address {{host}}, port {{port}}. It lists itself when it connects, under the serial on the unit's label.
empty.settings: An ez Share or FlashAir card, the O2 ring and an AirSense 11 over Bluetooth are chosen in Settings.

rename.hint: Only on this computer. The device keeps its own name.

forget.disabled: Only a device that is away can be forgotten.
forget.confirm: {{name}} stops being listed here and its waiting commands are dropped. Everything it delivered stays. If it connects again, it comes back as a new card.

costs.reboot: Restarting it now can cost tonight's data; the card keeps it.
costs.reset: Resetting its WiFi now stops the stream for the rest of the night; the card keeps the data.
costs.stream: Moving it now drops its stream for a moment; the card keeps the data.
costs.switch: The miner restarts to apply this; the card keeps the data.
costs.network: The bridge tests the new network and pauses its uplink for up to a minute; the card keeps the data.
costs.generic: This can cost tonight's data; the card keeps it.

result.queued: Waiting for the device: it goes when it connects.

action.backToCloud: Switch back to the CpapDash cloud
action.offline: Commands wait for the device: they go when it connects.

mule.manifestUnavailable: The published versions could not be read. A file you have can still be sent.
mule.fileHint: Send an image file you have, to the mule or the miner. It goes as soon as it is chosen.
mule.switchAnswered: taken; the miner is restarting with it
mule.resetConfirm: The unit forgets its WiFi and this computer's address, and goes back to its setup page. Only someone in the house can bring it back. Reset it?
mule.cloudConfirm: {{name}} will stream to the CpapDash cloud instead of this computer, and stops showing here. You can point it back to this computer from its setup page.
mule.pairHint: The machine shows a code once the unit starts pairing. Type it right away.

sleepbridge.learnedWaitingHint: Turn your machine on, put the mask on and breathe normally for 2 minutes, then take it off. The bridge then confirms the card.
sleepbridge.learnedMismatchHint: This bridge sees another card. Learn the card that is in it again with CpapDash Desktop (Export for HMS CPAP) and upload the new file on the Upload page.
sleepbridge.resetConfirm: The bridge forgets its network and stream address and restarts into its setup page. It keeps its serial, pairing and cloud token. Only someone in the house can set it up again. Reset it?
sleepbridge.cloudConfirm: {{name}} will restart and stream to the CpapDash cloud instead of this computer, and stops showing here. You can point it back to this computer from cpapdash.com.
sleepbridge.restateLabel: Ask for its card statement again

release.notPublished: Online updates are not available yet; upload a firmware file
release.noVariant: This bridge does not say which board it is: update it from a file.

sleepbridge.fileHint: Send a firmware image file (.bin) you have. It goes as soon as it is chosen, over the bridge's own connection.

config.heading: Settings on the bridge
config.needs101: The bridge's settings need firmware 1.0.1 or later.
config.notRead: Read them to see what the bridge holds.
config.passwordHint: Write only: never shown and never kept here.

risk.sequence_reuse: {{key}} went from {{from}} to {{to}}: the bridge reuses sequence numbers the cloud already has, and those writes are dropped.
risk.identity: {{key}} changed: a wrong value locks the bridge out of the cloud at its next start.

riskyConfirm.network: The bridge tests the new network first and goes back to the old one if it fails. Its uplink pauses for up to a minute. Send it?
riskyConfirm.identity: {{keys}}: a wrong value locks the bridge out of the cloud at its next start, with no way back but its setup page or a cable. Send it?
riskyConfirm.sequence: {{keys}}: lowering a counter makes the bridge reuse sequence numbers the cloud already has, and those writes are dropped. Send it?

o2ring.throughBridge: Read through {{url}}, not by this computer's Bluetooth.
o2ring.notAsked: Not talked to since hms-cpap started.
o2ring.readCollected: New data read from the ring.
o2ring.readNone: No new file on the ring.

source.bridge: A Mule & Miner in card mode: {{serial}}, firmware {{fw}}

syncOutcome.already_requested: A sync is already asked for.

source.findNone: Nothing answered. Multicast may be blocked on this network.
source.findFlashairNote: A FlashAir answers only on its own name (flashair.local), so it may not show here even when it works.

as11.notCompiled: This build has no Bluetooth: the AirSense 11 cannot be read from this computer.
as11.pullAsked: Asked: the summary is pulled within a few seconds.
as11.forgetPairingConfirm: This removes the keys the pairing made. The machine keeps this computer in its own paired list until you remove it there. Pairing again replaces the myAir app's pairing.
as11.pairNote: Pairing replaces the myAir app's Bluetooth pairing (and any bridge's) with this computer. myAir's nightly reports keep arriving over the machine's own modem.
as11.searching: Looking for the machine. This can take up to a minute.
as11.codeHint: Type it right away: the machine waits under a minute.
as11.done: Paired. The machine's summary is read from now on.
as11.errConnect: Could not reach the machine. Check that it is on and close by, and that the myAir app is not connected to it.
as11.errVerify: The machine refused the code. Start again and type the new code it shows.
as11.errTimeout: The machine did not answer in time. Start again.
as11.errBadCode: Type the digits shown on the machine's screen.
as11.errNoPairing: The pairing window closed. Start again.
as11.errDisabled: Turn this on and save first.
as11.errRadioOff: Bluetooth is switched off on this computer (rf-kill). Switch it on, or run rfkill unblock bluetooth, and try again.

ota.warnRecording: Your machine is recording. Updating now stops the unit for about a minute; the card keeps the night. Update anyway?
ota.held: Waiting for the machine to be idle: {{reason}}
ota.queued: Waiting for the unit to pick it up
ota.preparing: Preparing the update for this unit
ota.verifying: The unit is checking the new firmware
ota.notHeard: Not heard from since {{time}}. If it does not come back, unplug it for ten seconds and plug it in again.
ota.confirmedWhileRecording: Sent while the machine was recording, as confirmed.

fail.refused_image: The unit refused the image: {{detail}}. It still runs {{before}}.
fail.connection_lost: The connection dropped during the update. It still runs {{before}}.
fail.back_on_old_version: The unit restarted on {{before}}: the new firmware did not take.
fail.bake_failed: The update could not be prepared for this unit.
fail.image_unavailable: The firmware could not be downloaded.
fail.offline: The unit is not connected; nothing was sent.
fail.interrupted: The update was interrupted. The unit's next check-in shows what it runs.
fail.superseded: A newer update replaced this one.

advice.retry: Nothing broke. Try again; if it repeats, contact support.
advice.checkPower: Check the unit is powered and on WiFi, then try again.
advice.bringOnline: Bring it online; the update was not sent.
advice.wait: Wait for the unit's next check-in; its version then shows what it runs.
